termsOfService.title: Terms of Service
termsOfService.intro: By accessing or using Vigil, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms of Service. Please read them carefully before using our platform.

definitions.title: 1. Definitions
definitions.vigil: "Vigil" refers to the social media platform operated by Vigil Technologies Ltd.
definitions.user: "User" refers to any person who accesses or uses Vigil services.
definitions.content: "Content" includes posts, comments, images, videos, audios, polls, and any other material shared on the platform.
definitions.premiumServices: "Premium Services" refers to paid plans Basic ($3.99), Pro ($8.99), and Premium ($19.99).

acceptance.title: 2. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your access to and use of the Vigil application and all services, features, content, and functionalities offered by us. If you do not agree to these Terms, do not use Vigil. You must be at least 13 years old to use our services.

servicesDescription.title: 3. Description of Services
servicesDescription.posts: Posts and Interactions: Creation of posts with text (280-25,000 characters depending on the plan), images, videos, audio, polls, and evidence boards for theories. Like, comment, and share system.
servicesDescription.communities: Communities: Creation and participation in thematic communities (available for Pro and Premium users).
servicesDescription.library: Library: Access to e-books and documents (available for Pro and Premium users).
servicesDescription.chatRooms: Chat Rooms: Real-time chat rooms (available only for Premium users).
servicesDescription.timeline: Historical Timeline: Interactive visualization of historical events.
servicesDescription.messages: Private Messages: Direct messaging system between users.

plans.title: 4. Plans and Subscriptions
plans.pro: Pro ($8.99/mo): 5,000 characters, access to communities and library, reduced ads.
plans.premium: Premium ($19.99/mo): 25,000 characters, community creation, chat rooms, no ads.
plans.paymentInfo: Payments are processed through Stripe. Subscriptions renew automatically and can be canceled at any time.

conductRules.title: 5. Code of Conduct
rules: Post illegal, defamatory, obscene, threatening content or content that violates third-party rights
Harass, intimidate, or threaten other users
Deliberately share false or misleading information
Use the platform for spam or unauthorized commercial activities
Attempt to access other users' accounts or compromise platform security
Post theories that incite violence or hate against specific groups

intellectualProperty.title: 6. User Content and Intellectual Property
intellectualProperty.content1: You retain ownership of all content you post on Vigil. However, by posting content, you grant us a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license to use, reproduce, modify, adapt, publish, translate, distribute, and display such content in connection with our services.
intellectualProperty.content2: You are responsible for ensuring that you have all necessary rights to the content you post and that such content does not violate third-party intellectual property rights.

moderation.title: 7. Moderation and Content Removal
moderation.intro: We reserve the right to review, moderate, and remove any content that violates these Terms or our community guidelines. Our moderation system includes:
items: Automated moderation to detect inappropriate content
Manual review by our moderation team
User reporting system
Appeal process for moderation decisions

termination.title: 8. Account Suspension and Termination
termination.intro: We may suspend or terminate your account if you:
items: Repeatedly violate these Terms or our guidelines
Engage in activities that compromise platform security
Use the platform for illegal activities
termination.closing: You may terminate your account at any time through account settings. Upon termination, your data will be handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

liability.title: 9. Limitations of Liability
liability.intro: Vigil is provided "as is" and "as available". We do not guarantee that the service will be uninterrupted, secure, or error-free. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we shall not be liable for:
items: Indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages
Loss of profits, data, or business opportunities
Content posted by other users
Temporary service interruptions

indemnification.title: 10. Indemnification
indemnification.content: You agree to indemnify and hold harmless Vigil, its affiliates, directors, employees, and agents from any claims, liabilities, damages, losses, and expenses (including legal fees) arising from your use of the platform or violation of these Terms.

disputeResolution.title: 11. Dispute Resolution
disputeResolution.intro: Any dispute arising from these Terms shall be resolved through:
items: Direct negotiation between the parties
Mediation, if necessary
Binding arbitration as a last resort

changes.title: 12. Changes to Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to modify these Terms at any time. We will notify you of significant changes through the platform or by email. Continued use of services after changes constitutes acceptance of the new Terms.

governingLaw.title: 13. Governing Law and Jurisdiction
governingLaw.content: These Terms are governed by the laws of Brazil, without regard to conflict of law provisions. Any legal action related to these Terms shall be submitted to the exclusive jurisdiction of Brazilian courts.

contact.title: 14. Contact
contact.intro: For questions regarding these Terms, please contact us:

termsOfService.footer: By using Vigil, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At Vigil, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and protect your personal information in compliance with LGPD, GDPR, and CCPA.

direct.title: 1.1 Information Provided Directly
items: Registration data: username, email, password (encrypted), date of birth
Profile information: bio, profile picture, location (optional)
Content: posts, comments, private messages, media uploads
Payment data: information processed by Stripe for Premium subscriptions
Communications: messages sent to our support

automatic.title: 1.2 Information Collected Automatically
items: Usage data: interactions with posts, time spent on platform, features used
Technical information: IP address, browser type, operating system, device
Location data: approximate location based on IP (if allowed)
Cookies and similar technologies: preferences, sessions, usage analysis
Activity logs: access times, actions performed on the platform

thirdParty.title: 1.3 Third-Party Information
items: Social authentication data (if you choose to login with Google/Facebook)
Stripe payment information for subscription processing
Analytics data from service providers (Google Analytics, etc.)

legalBasis.title: 2. Legal Basis for Processing (LGPD/GDPR)
legalBasis.consent: Consent: For marketing, non-essential cookies, and optional data
legalBasis.contract: Contract execution: To provide our services and process payments
legalBasis.legitimateInterest: Legitimate interest: For security, fraud prevention, and service improvements
legalBasis.legalObligation: Legal obligation: For compliance with applicable laws

usage.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
usage.operation: Service Operation: Provide Vigil functionalities, process transactions, manage accounts
usage.personalization: Personalization: Customize your experience, recommend relevant content, adjust settings
usage.communication: Communication: Send notifications, service updates, customer support
usage.security: Security: Detect fraud, prevent abuse, protect platform integrity
usage.analytics: Analysis: Understand how users interact with the platform, improve features
usage.compliance: Legal Compliance: Comply with legal and regulatory obligations

noSale.title: 4.1 We Do Not Sell Your Data
noSale.content: We never sell your personal information to third parties for commercial purposes.

authorized.title: 4.2 Authorized Sharing
items: Service Providers: Stripe (payments), Supabase (database), Google (analytics)
Advertising Partners: Aggregated and anonymized data for relevant ads
Authorities: When required by law or to protect legal rights
Corporate Transfers: In case of merger, acquisition, or sale of assets

internationalTransfer.title: 5. International Data Transfers
internationalTransfer.intro: Your data may be transferred and processed in countries outside Brazil/EU. We ensure adequate protection through:
items: Standard contractual clauses approved by the European Commission
Adequacy certifications (Privacy Shield, etc.)
Appropriate technical and organizational security measures

retention.title: 6. Data Retention
retention.account: Account Data: Kept while your account is active
retention.content: Public Content: Kept indefinitely unless you request removal
retention.payment: Payment Data: Kept according to tax requirements (up to 7 years)
retention.security: Security Logs: Kept for up to 2 years for security purposes
retention.marketing: Marketing Data: Kept until you withdraw consent

universal.title: 7.1 Universal Rights
items: Access: Request a copy of your personal data
Rectification: Correct inaccurate or incomplete data
Deletion: Request removal of your data ("right to be forgotten")
Portability: Receive your data in a structured format
Objection: Object to processing based on legitimate interest

specific.title: 7.2 Jurisdiction-Specific Rights
specific.gdpr: GDPR (EU): Right to restriction of processing, right not to be subject to automated decisions
specific.ccpa: CCPA (California): Right to know, right to delete, right to opt-out of sale
specific.lgpd: LGPD (Brazil): Right to confirmation, access, correction, anonymization, portability

exerciseRights.title: 8. How to Exercise Your Rights
exerciseRights.account: Account Settings: Many options are available directly in settings
exerciseRights.form: Online Form: Use our privacy request form (under development)
exerciseRights.response: Response Time: We will respond within 30 days (LGPD) or 1 month (GDPR)

types.title: 9.1 Types of Cookies
items: Essential: Necessary for basic platform functioning
Functional: Remember your preferences and settings
Analytical: Help us understand how you use Vigil
Advertising: Personalize ads based on your interests

management.title: 9.2 Cookie Management
management.content: You can manage cookies through your browser settings or our privacy settings.

security.title: 10. Data Security
security.intro: We implement technical and organizational measures to protect your data:
items: Encryption in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and at rest
Strict access controls and multi-factor authentication
Continuous security monitoring and threat detection
Regular security audits and penetration testing
Employee training on security practices

dataBreach.title: 11. Data Breach Notification
dataBreach.intro: In case of a data breach that may result in risk to your rights and freedoms:
items: We will notify competent authorities within 72 hours
We will inform affected users without undue delay
We will take immediate measures to contain and remedy the breach
We will provide guidance on protective measures

minors.title: 12. Privacy of Minors
minors.content1: Our services are intended for users aged 13 or older. If we discover we have collected data from minors under 13 without proper parental consent, we will take steps to delete that information.
minors.content2: For users aged 13-18, we implement additional protections as required by applicable laws.

changes.title: 13. Changes to this Policy
changes.intro: We may update this Policy periodically. When we make significant changes:
items: We will notify you through the platform or by email
We will provide a summary of key changes
We will request new consent when required by law
We will keep previous versions available for consultation

authorities.title: 15. Supervisory Authorities
authorities.intro: You have the right to lodge complaints with data protection authorities:
authorities.eu: European Union: Data protection authority of your country

privacyPolicy.footer: This Privacy Policy was drafted to ensure transparency regarding our data practices and compliance with applicable data protection laws.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how Vigil uses cookies and similar technologies to recognize you when you visit our application. It explains what these technologies are and why we use them, as well as your rights to control our use of them.

whatAreCookies.title: 1. What are cookies?
whatAreCookies.content: Cookies are small data files that are placed on your computer or mobile device when you visit a website. Cookies are widely used by website owners to make their websites work, or to work more efficiently, as well as to provide reporting information.

howWeUse.title: 2. How do we use cookies?
howWeUse.content1: We use cookies for several reasons, including to authenticate users, remember your preferences, personalize content, and analyze site traffic. The specific types of cookies we use include essential, performance, and functionality cookies.
howWeUse.content2: By using Vigil, you agree to the use of cookies in accordance with this policy.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: This document sets forth the limitations of liability and disclaimers applicable to the use of the Vigil platform. Please read carefully before using our services.

nature.title: 1. Nature of Information
nature.content: The information provided on Vigil is for general information, discussion, and entertainment purposes only. We do not guarantee the accuracy, completeness, timeliness, or usefulness of any information on the platform.
nature.important: Important: Any reliance you place on information obtained through Vigil is strictly at your own risk.

speculative.title: 2. Theoretical and Speculative Content
speculative.intro: Vigil is a platform dedicated to sharing and discussing theories, speculations, and analyses. We expressly acknowledge that:
items: Theories are by nature speculative and may not reflect verified facts
Discussions may include controversial or unproven content
Different users may have conflicting interpretations of the same events
Content may evolve as new information becomes available

userContent.title: 3. Responsibility for User Content
userContent.content: Opinions, theories, analyses, and information expressed by users are their sole responsibility and do not necessarily reflect the opinions, beliefs, or positions of Vigil or its operators.
userContent.notEndorsed: We do not endorse, verify, or guarantee:
items: The truthfulness of any theory or information posted by users
The accuracy of analyses or interpretations shared
The reliability of sources cited by users
The suitability of any content for specific purposes

library.title: 4. Content Library and Historical Timeline
library.intro: Our library and historical timeline features are provided for educational and informational purposes:
items: Content may be subject to third-party copyrights
We do not guarantee the historical accuracy of all materials
Historical interpretations may vary among different sources
Some content may be outdated or incomplete

professionalAdvice.title: 5. No Professional Advice
professionalAdvice.intro: Information on Vigil is NOT intended to be, and should not be construed as:
items: Legal Advice: We do not provide legal guidance
Financial Advice: We do not offer investment advice
Medical Advice: We do not provide medical or health guidance
Psychological Advice: We do not offer therapy or mental counseling
Technical Advice: We do not provide professional technical guidance
professionalAdvice.conclusion: Always seek the advice of qualified professionals for any specific questions you may have.

externalLinks.title: 6. External Links and Third-Party Content
externalLinks.intro: Vigil may contain links to external websites and references to third-party content:
items: We do not control or endorse the content of external sites
We are not responsible for the accuracy or reliability of external sources
External links are provided for convenience only
Access to third-party sites is at your own risk

availability.title: 7. Service Availability Guarantees
availability.intro: While we strive to keep Vigil available 24/7, we do not guarantee:
items: Uninterrupted availability of services
Absence of technical errors or bugs
Compatibility with all devices or browsers
Specific speed or performance
User data backup or recovery

limitations.title: 8. Limitations of Liability
limitations.intro: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Vigil and its operators shall not be liable for:
items: Direct Damages: Financial losses arising from platform use
Indirect Damages: Loss of profits, opportunities, or data
Consequential Damages: Results of actions based on platform content
Punitive Damages: Penalties or fines related to use
Moral Damages: Embarrassment or damage to reputation

indemnification.title: 9. User Indemnification
indemnification.intro: You agree to indemnify and hold harmless Vigil, its affiliates, directors, employees, and agents from any:
items: Claims arising from your use of the platform
Violations of this Disclaimer
Violations of third-party rights
Content you post or share
Inappropriate use of Premium services

forceMajeure.title: 10. Force Majeure
forceMajeure.intro: We shall not be liable for failures or delays in performance resulting from circumstances beyond our reasonable control, including:
items: Natural disasters, wars, terrorism
Internet or power infrastructure failures
Government actions or regulatory changes
Cyber attacks or third-party security breaches
Pandemics or public health emergencies

modifications.title: 11. Modifications to Services
items: Modify, suspend, or discontinue any aspect of services
Change features available in different plans
Implement new policies or procedures
Update our technical infrastructure
modifications.conclusion: We will make reasonable efforts to notify users of significant changes.

jurisdiction.title: 12. Jurisdiction and Governing Law
jurisdiction.content1: This Disclaimer is governed by the laws of Brazil. Any dispute related to these terms shall be submitted to the exclusive jurisdiction of competent Brazilian courts.
jurisdiction.content2: If any provision of these terms is found to be invalid, the remaining provisions shall remain in full force.

alert.title: Important Notice
alert.content: By using Vigil, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to all limitations of liability and disclaimers set forth in this document.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Policy
accessibility.intro: At Vigil, we are committed to making our platform accessible to everyone, regardless of their abilities or disabilities. We believe everyone should have the opportunity to explore theories and connect with the community.

commitment.title: 1. Our Commitment
commitment.content1: Vigil is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We are continuously improving the user experience for everyone and applying relevant accessibility standards.
commitment.content2: Our goal is to make Vigil accessible to the widest possible audience, regardless of technology or ability.

compliance.title: 2. Compliance with Standards
compliance.intro: We are working to comply with:
items: WCAG 2.1 Level AA: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines
Section 508: US government accessibility standards
EN 301 549: European accessibility standard
Brazilian Inclusion Law (LBI): Statute of the Person with Disabilities

keyboard.title: 3.1 Keyboard Navigation
items: All interactive elements are accessible via keyboard
Logical navigation order with Tab
Clear visual focus indicators
Keyboard shortcuts for main functions

screenReaders.title: 3.2 Screen Reader Support
items: Proper semantic markup (HTML5)
ARIA attributes for complex elements
Descriptive alternative text for images
Clear labels for forms and controls
Announcements of dynamic content changes

visualDesign.title: 3.3 Accessible Visual Design
items: Color contrast per WCAG AA (4.5:1 for normal text)
Resizable text up to 200% without loss of functionality
No reliance solely on color to convey information
Dark mode to reduce eye strain
Readable fonts and adequate spacing

multimedia.title: 3.4 Multimedia Content
items: Captions for videos (when applicable)
Transcripts for audio content
Accessible playback controls
Text alternatives for charts and infographics

assistiveTech.title: 4. Supported Assistive Technologies
assistiveTech.intro: Vigil has been tested and is compatible with:
items: Screen Readers: NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, TalkBack
Voice Navigation: Dragon NaturallySpeaking
Screen Magnifiers: ZoomText, MAGic
High Contrast Browsers: Windows high contrast mode
Mobile Devices: iOS and Android accessibility features

posts.title: 5.1 Posts and Interactions
items: Like, comment, and share buttons with descriptive labels
Interaction counters announced by screen readers
Fully accessible post creation forms
Clear navigation between posts and comments

communities.title: 5.2 Communities and Navigation
items: Consistent and predictable navigation structure
Breadcrumbs for location orientation
Keyboard accessible filters and search
Clear community status indicators (public/private)

chat.title: 5.3 Chat and Messages
items: New message notifications for screen readers
Keyboard navigation in conversations
Message status indicators (sent, read)
Input fields with clear labels

improvement.title: 6. Continuous Improvement Process
improvement.intro: Our commitment to accessibility is ongoing:
items: Regular Audits: Quarterly accessibility evaluations
User Testing: Feedback from users with disabilities
Team Training: Continuous accessibility training
Incremental Updates: Improvements based on feedback and new standards

shortTerm.title: Short Term (next 3 months):
items: Complete implementation of ARIA labels in all components
Improved visual focus indicators
Optimization for mobile screen readers

mediumTerm.title: Medium Term (next 6 months):
items: Implementation of custom high contrast mode
Addition of advanced keyboard shortcuts
Enhanced support for screen magnifiers

longTerm.title: Long Term (next year):
items: Full WCAG 2.1 AA certification
Implementation of cognitive accessibility features
Support for emerging assistive technologies

alternatives.title: 8. Alternatives for Inaccessible Content
alternatives.intro: When content cannot be fully accessible, we provide:
items: Detailed text descriptions for complex visual elements
Alternative formats for documents (plain text, audio)
Summaries of multimedia content
Direct contact for personalized assistance

feedback.title: 9. Feedback and Support
feedback.intro: We value your feedback on Vigil's accessibility:
items: Email: accessibility@vigil.com
Feedback Form: Available in account settings
Phone: [Number to be defined] (business hours)
Support Chat: Available 24/7 with assistive technology support
feedback.response: We will respond to all accessibility inquiries within 48 hours.

compliance_legal.title: 10. Legal Compliance
compliance_legal.intro: We are committed to complying with all applicable accessibility laws:
items: Brazil: Brazilian Inclusion Law (Law 13.146/2015)
United States: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)
European Union: European Accessibility Act
International: UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities

resources.title: 11. Additional Resources
resources.intro: To help you use Vigil more effectively:
items: Accessibility Guide: Detailed tutorial on accessible features
Keyboard Shortcuts: Complete list available by pressing Ctrl+?
Accessibility Settings: Dedicated panel in account settings
Technical Documentation: For assistive technology developers

alert.title: Ongoing Commitment
alert.content: Accessibility is an ongoing journey. We are committed to constantly improving the experience for all users. If you encounter any barriers or have suggestions, please contact us.
